title: A Cure for Heart Trouble
summaryZh: 我們的心常被驕傲與偶像蒙蔽，唯有神能除掉我們剛硬的石心。
lines: Would you like to have your heart illuminated by the Spirit of God?
你想要讓神的靈光照你的心嗎？
And then the Bible says our hearts are deceitful.
接著聖經說，我們的心是詭詐的。
The heart is deceitful above all things.
Above all things your heart is deceitful.
你們的心比萬物都詭詐。
And then in Psalm 101 it says that our hearts are proud.
然後在《詩篇》第一百零一篇說，我們的心是驕傲的。
"Him that hath a high look and a proud heart, I'll not recognize," says God.
神說：「眼目高傲、心裡驕縱的，我必不容他。」
Then the Bible says our hearts are rebellious.
然後聖經說我們的心是悖逆的。
"But this people hath a revolting and rebellious heart.
The Bible says that our hearts are idolatrous.
聖經說我們的心充滿偶像。
We think of other things more than we think of God.
我們想別的事比想神還要多。
And anything that you think more of than you do of God becomes idolatry.
任何你認為比神更重要的事物，就成了偶像崇拜。
It may be that box in the corner in your room that we call television.
可能是你房間角落裡那個我們稱為電視的盒子。
And you spend more time in television than you do in the Bible.
你花在電視上的時間比花在聖經上的時間還多。
More time thinking about what you've seen on the television than you do in the Bible.
花更多時間去想你在電視上看到的，而不是聖經裡的內容。
And sometimes I have to get down on my knees and confess that I've done the same thing.
有時候我必須雙膝跪下，承認我也做了同樣的事。
And I say, "O God, cleanse me and forgive me.
我說：「神啊，求祢潔淨我、赦免我。
"I've spent too much time in front of that screen tonight.
「今晚我在那螢幕前花太多時間了。
"I should have been reading and soaking up Your word and spending time in prayer for people in Africa,
「我本來應該閱讀、吸收祢的話語，並花時間為非洲的人代禱，
"and people in other parts of the world where there's so much hunger and so much homelessness and so much suffering."
「以及世界其他地方那些面臨極大飢荒、無家可歸和苦難的人們代禱。」
And then the Bible says our hearts are stony.
接著聖經說我們的心是石心。
"And I will take the stony heart out of their flesh."
「我又要從他們肉體中除掉石心。」
The Bible says our hearts are stony, hard, cold and barren.
聖經說我們的心是如石頭般剛硬、冰冷且荒蕪的。
That's how God diagnoses your heart.
神就是這樣診斷你的心的。
You go to a cardiologist to get diagnosed and he puts instruments on you, gives you a stress test or whatever.
你去心臟科醫師那裡做診斷，他在你身上裝儀器，給你做壓力測試什麼的。
Or you take a cardiogram or take an angiogram.
或是做心電圖、血管攝影。
I remember the first time I had an angiogram at the Mayo Clinic in Rochester, Minnesota.
我記得第一次在明尼蘇達州羅徹斯特的梅奧診所做血管攝影時，
I was a little bit nervous about it, and I lay there and I said to the doctor—there were several doctors—I said,
我有點緊張，我躺在那裡，對醫生說——那裡有好幾位醫生——我說：
"When are you going to insert that tube and put that dye in my heart?" because they had a big screen up there.
「你們什麼時候要插入管子，把顯影劑打進我的心臟？」因為上面有一個大螢幕。
He said, "It's already in. Look up there."
他說：「已經進去了。你看上面。」
I didn't even know it when they did it.
他們做的時候我甚至都沒感覺。
And I'd been told by people, "Oh my," and they had me nervous about it.
之前有人告訴我：「我的天啊！」他們讓我對此感到很緊張。
The Bible also says that our hearts can be hardened.
聖經也說我們的心可能會變得剛硬。
You see, Pharaoh, I was watching a little bit of The Ten Commandments the other night when I was home.
你看，法老——前幾天晚上我在家時看了一點《十誡》這部電影。
They had it running on one of the stations.
當時有個電視台正在播。
And how Pharaoh hardened his heart.
而法老是如何使他的心剛硬的。
In Exodus 7 it says, "And the Lord said unto Moses, Pharaoh's heart is hard; he refuses to let the people go."
在《出埃及記》第七章說：「耶和華對摩西說：法老心裡剛硬，不肯容百姓去。」
God sent ten plagues to soften Pharaoh up, and he promised every time he'd let the people of Israel leave Egypt.
神降下十災來軟化法老，而他每一次都答應會讓以色列人離開埃及。
